description: Bone meal on the three Chrono Dawn saplings grows them into trees. Inside the Chrono Dawn dimension no vanilla dirt is left under the trunk: a sapling on vanilla grass leaves Temporal Dirt, and one on Temporal Grass keeps the Temporal Grass (vanilla tree growth only replaces ground outside #minecraft:dirt or plain grass, and the grass under the log decays to Temporal Dirt on a later random tick). In the Overworld a sapling on vanilla grass leaves vanilla dirt. Each sapling is set to stage 1, so one successful bone meal grows it; the player right-clicks it with bone meal up to 15 times (each use succeeds with 45% chance, and clicks after growth land on the log and do nothing). The platforms are in the sky so the trees have room and a plain background. Mob spawning is off while it runs, so monsters do not gather on the platforms.
steps: item replace entity ${player} hotbar.0 with minecraft:bone_meal 64
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run forceload add 196 -4 247 47

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn if loaded 236 200 36

execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run setblock 204 201 4 chronodawn:time_wood_sapling[stage=1]

execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run setblock 204 201 36 chronodawn:time_wood_sapling[stage=1]

steps.note: In the Chrono Dawn dimension, two rows of trees grown with bone meal on a Temporal Grass platform in the sky: Time Wood (left), Dark Time Wood with a 2x2 trunk (middle), Ancient Time Wood (right). The front row grew on Temporal Grass, the back row on vanilla grass blocks. The block under each trunk is covered by the trunk itself, so the root checks in the report verify it; this shot shows that all trees grew and that leaves and logs render with their textures.

The back row in Chrono Dawn from closer: Time Wood, Dark Time Wood and Ancient Time Wood grown on vanilla grass blocks. All three grew; the vanilla grass around the trunks stays. The block under each trunk is hidden by the trunk, and the root checks in the report verify it is Temporal Dirt.
